steps.text: Prepare the filter insert by folding the paper filter in half to create a semi-circle, and in half again to create a quarter-circle
Grind the coffee beans until the coffee grounds are the consistency of coarse sand, about 20 seconds
Place the dripper on top of a coffee mug
Place the paper filter in the dripper
spread open filter in dripper to create a cone
Transfer the grounds to the filter cone
Boil the water. (While the water is boiling, assemble the filter cone)
Once the water has boiled, check the temperature of the water. (The water should be between 195-205 degrees Fahrenheit or between 91-96 degrees Celsius. If the water is too hot, let it cool briefly.)
Pour a small amount of water into the filter to wet the grounds
Wait about 30 seconds for the coffee to bloom. (You will see small bubbles or foam on the coffee grounds during this step.)
Slowly pour the rest of the water over the grounds in a circular motion. Do not overfill beyond the top of the paper filter
Let the coffee drain completely into the mug before removing the dripper
Discard the paper filter and coffee grounds
